statements.quote: Approximately $85.0 million of the increase was due to revenue generated related to our HPC Hosting Business, with approximately $73.0 million related to tenant fit-out services and $12.0 million related to rental revenues as ELN-02 at Polaris Forge 1 fully energized during the current quarter.
statements.notes: Quarterly figure for fiscal Q2 2026 (three months ended 2025-11-30), not full-year fiscal 2026. HPC Hosting is the AI/HPC data-center lease business for CoreWeave. The sentence states it as part of the year-over-year increase, but the prior-year quarter had no HPC revenue. $73.0M of it is tenant fit-out services and $12.0M is lease revenue. The legacy Data Center Hosting Business revenue ($41.6M, blockchain hosting) is excluded as not AI. The ~$5B (p02/p05) and ~$16B (p05) prospective lease revenue figures span multi-year lease terms with no fiscal year, so they are not recorded.

none_found.reason: No sentence states capital expenditures for a fiscal year. p09 calls Polaris Forge 2 a '$3 billion, 200 MW data center campus', but that is a project cost with no period, not fiscal-year capex. p07's $400B is hyperscalers' capex, not the company's own.

No sentence quantifies or attributes R&D, infrastructure or headcount operating expenses to AI. The $69.5M tenant fit-out expense in p13 is quarterly cost of revenues for services billed to the tenant, not opex.
